title: Znojmo
instructions: Cut up onion and bacon and fry it up. Add pieces of meat.
Once meat has changed color, add a spoon of mustard and pepper. Mix up, add broth, and cook covered.
Chop up pickles into small cubes, and once the meat is tender, add it in.
Fry flour and add in to thicken.
Cook eggs until firm, chop it up into cubes. Do not add yet.
Once meat is tender, add another spoon of mustard, and cook 15 more mins.
